title: Organiser
description: The Battle for Middle-earth 2026 is organised by Moravian LARP, z. s. (Company ID 22669167, registered in Brno). Identification, contacts and scope of activities.
subtitle: Moravian LARP, z. s. — the association organising The Lord of the Rings, Battle for Middle-earth.
intro: The Lord of the Rings — Battle for Middle-earth is a multi-day larp event organised by Moravian LARP, z. s. This page summarises the full identification of the organiser for the public, partners, media, municipal authorities and other entities.
f_register_value: L 12656 at the Regional Court in Brno
activity_intro: The main activity of the association is organising larp events and related community activities, in particular:
activity_1_pre: preparation and running of the multi-day larp event
activity_1_strong: The Lord of the Rings — Battle for Middle-earth
activity_2_post: for our own events and events where we organise registration,
activity_3: community activities in larp, costuming, historicising re-enactment and fantasy culture,
activity_4: cooperation with media, cultural and educational entities.
nonprofit_note: The association is a non-profit organisation. Registration fees are used solely to cover costs of preparing and running the event, its facilities and related operational needs.
contact_general_desc: Registration, payments, participant enquiries, GDPR, photos, organisational matters.
contact_media_desc: Logo download, photos, event facts, press contact.
contact_vendors_desc: For sellers of costumes, fabrics, weapons, jewellery and themed gear.
contact_gdpr_desc: Data subject rights, retention, contact for erasure / correction.
updated: Updated: 30 April 2026. If the entry in the association register changes, this page will be updated.
